description: Ramus semantic source understanding acceptance suite. Expectations are semantic, not hardcoded production answers.

cases.name: Unlabeled thesis excerpt with two known participants
should: Generate an idea tree from meaningful material without timestamps
Never create a contributor from an ordinary heading, phrase, sentence, or professor mentioned in text
Represent a changed thesis recommendation after new CV evidence
Distinguish original candidate topics from later concerns about evidence and robustness
Keep ambiguous passage authors as null despite a two-person participant constraint
should_not: Create contributors named 三份方向分得很开 or LLM 自己给的区间
Assume all copied text was written by the importer
Invent timestamps or claim every paragraph has an identified speaker

cases.name: Explicit two-person conversation
should: Exactly two verified speakers: Me and Claude
Keep Aron and Mats as mentioned names, not contributors
Link changed recommendation to new CV evidence where supported
Retain source text and message order

cases.name: Copied webpage with irrelevant site notice
should: Make Grow the tree available despite webpage warning
Prefer content ideas about packaging PEP discoverability
Preserve original webpage copy in archive
Explain missing-post uncertainty without refusing
should_not: Treat navigation, statistics, or the site-wide maintenance announcement as the central idea
Claim the text is all 39 original forum posts

cases.name: Real four-person group chat
should: Keep exactly four verified speakers: Ana Lind, Bo Berg, Cy Wang, Dina Ali
Keep Aron Larsson as a mentioned person only
Reconstruct movement from allergen-only idea to a bilingual lean checklist product
Preserve timestamps, quoted/reply metadata if present and idea provenance

cases.name: Solo rough coffee business notes
should: Produce useful idea tree without assigning a person or time without evidence
Preserve branches for fixed shop, mobile coffee cart, weekend popup
Represent rent, permits, weather, validation plan and later research needs
Allow stated vs inferred rationale inspection

cases.name: Markdown and colon-rich prose are not speakers
should: Create zero confirmed contributors from body headings or colon-rich sentences
Preserve themes of model stability and evidence verification
should_not: Create Aron Larsson or Mats as speakers
Reject the input because no timestamps exist

cases.name: Real public Discourse regression
should: Preserve 39 posts and 12 original contributors when available from the public API
Retain author/time/reply metadata without AI overwriting
Never import unrelated global security banners as original discussion posts
Maintain distinctions among Category, Type, Track and separate index-page alternatives

cross_cutting: Verbatim evidence quote matches the original or validated normalized source
No destructive rewrites of existing Gardens or the original archive
Stated link supported by explicit source evidence; inferred link marked as inferred
Failures degrade gracefully and preserve source material
Existing unit and integration tests remain passing
Tree colors only represent genuine authors; unknown is neutral
